notes.title: 0.21 Update Announcement!! Enter the chariot!
notes.notes:
1. The vehicle system has been launched
At present, there are four vehicles available on the new map for players to drive and collide with zombies, namely a truck and a RV, as well as a sedan and an SUV. If the vehicle overturns, it can be returned to normal by pressing the R key.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44759596/9106bae4932a8180a06d78e8f7ec8ff3e3bf0d42.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44759596/14c6e7282310cd91924426e927bdea8465ebd447.png
2. Future plans 
Some time in the future I plan to introduce a collection system that can modify the vehicle, unlock the equipment, you can add more cool, lethal equipment to the car, if you have any ideas, please let me know.

notes.title: 《Fire Fly》0.16 Update Announcement! Add multiple languages! Partial problem fix!
notes.notes:
Added Japanese, Traditional Chinese, Spanish, Russian 
 You can switch languages through the bottom right corner of the game's main interface 
 {STEAL_CLAN_IMAGE}/44759596/ff2dd00d8961824180eadaca8bae5f1fce7f6da8.png
 Partial problem fixing 
 1. Replaced AK-47 and SCAR-L with more suitable gunshots 
 2. Adjusted the third person camera. The original camera received higher feedback from players. In this update, I have moved the camera down as a whole 
 3. Adjusted the picking and emitting range of the item

notes.title: 《Fire Fly》Update announcement for version 0.14！！！
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, the 0.14 update of《Firefly》has been released！
New content：Molotov cocktails ! Item tips ! New test map ! A small map!

1.Molotov cocktails ! Enjoy the lost thrill of burning! Players can switch projectiles by completing the "T" key on the keyboard.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44759596/e1954eed55de5be1623ff393f1d84e6c31b44307.png

2.Item tips ! Players close to a certain range of items show a circle prompt, more convenient for players to find supplies! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44759596/921489d1dc08bf2397d934f7dc3dd1af0e2b2600.png

3.New test map!《澳大利亚村庄》
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44759596/2b7a11bb8ca63d6f58e748b48ac6ce469d23e03d.png

4.A small map! For players to test！
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44759596/d0d15e876331841c91aafa6b1d72160ec431e7fd.png

This is the update of BATA: 0.14, more content stay tuned!

Coming soon Japanese
